request.objective: Start at https://www.flightaware.com/. Compare available plans for the AeroAPI on Flightaware.

result.excerpt:
FlightAware lists three AeroAPI plans: **Personal, Standard, and Premium**. Their comparison is:

| Feature | Personal | Standard | Premium |
|---|---|---|---|
| Monthly minimum | None | $100/month | $1,000/month |
| Query pricing | Per-query fees; the pricing table notes up to $5 free per month, or $10 for ADS-B feeders | Per-query fees; $100/month minimum | Per-query fees; $1,000/month minimum |
| Result-set rate limit | 10/minute | 5/second | 100/second |
| Historical results allowance | Not included | 500,000 result sets/month | 500,000 result sets/month |
| Alerts and historical flight data | Alerts and historical data not included | Included | Included |
| Foresight and Aireon space-based ADS-B | Not included | Not included | Included; contact FlightAware to enable, and restrictions apply |
| Permitted use | Personal or academic use | Business internal use and B2C commercialization; not B2B commercialization | Business internal use and B2C and B2B commercialization |
| Other listed features | Static maps and imagery | Static maps and imagery, volume discounts, email support, invoicing | Static maps and imagery, volume discounts, email and phone support, invoicing, and a 99.5% uptime guarantee |

The table also lists **email support** for Standard and Premium, **phone support** only for Premium, and no uptime guarantee for Personal or Standard. Static maps and imagery are included in all three plans.

Per-query fees vary by endpoint. Examples include **$0.050/result set** for flight searches, **$0.005** for `GET /flights/{ident}`, **$0.010** for a current-position lookup, and **$0.030** for a flight map.

**Bottom line:** Personal has no monthly minimum and is limited to personal or academic use. Standard adds business and historical-data features for a $100 monthl
